mentions.name: Dockside
mentions.description: A small macOS app that makes use of the unused space around the Dock (especially on widescreens). It is non-intrusive and lets users drag & drop files, jot quick notes, and add shortcuts right beside the Dock so they are always handy without cluttering the desktop. Currently adding requested features such as vertical Dock support and refining for the Tahoe release.
mentions.problem: The unused space around the macOS Dock goes to waste, and keeping files, notes, or shortcuts handy can clutter the desktop.
mentions.source_excerpt: I worked on Dockside last year (https://hachipoo.com/dockside-app) — a small macOS app that makes use of the unused space around the Dock (especially nice on widescreens). It’s non-intrusive and lets you drag & drop files, jot quick notes, or add shortcuts right beside the Dock so they’re always handy without cluttering the desktop.
